card.name: Words before a named award or title
card.fires_on: Small words such as 'the', 'of' or an opening quote right before a proper name, mostly an award or honor name in a list. It also fires on scattered other spots in biography and reference text.

modes.label: Scattered reference text
modes.description: Parts of citations, catalogue entries or dates in reference material.

card.writes: It suppresses 'Hall' and 'hero' words, so it steers away from naming a hall or hero next.
card.plain: It fires on small words before a name, mostly award names in a list, and makes 'Hall' or 'hero' less likely next.
